title: Request detail
body: Submitted. No payment is required for this request.

sections.title: Submitted · Complete
sections.body: The request was received. The confirmed reference and time belong here when available.

sections.title: Ready for pickup or download · Upcoming
sections.body: No document or pickup code has been issued.

annotation: Remap G04.7 View request to this key, not the existing Ready free-request example. This is an isolated design receipt/detail fixture with no invented live personal reference. Actual header/history use server-confirmed reference, actor and time. Inquiry recipient is the originating office. No payment, file or pickup action. Office review is explanatory display state, not a new persisted request-status enum.

title: Payment declaration
body: Enter the authorized amount for this service. Cashiering handles payment.
annotation: Required-fee variant. Amount is genuinely blank and Save remains disabled. No official amount or successful edit is invented. Enable only with a valid authorized amount and server permissions. Root remaps G05.1 choice routes to this key and G05.pending, and removes the amount field from G05.1 Free. Registrar and enrollment certificate are illustrative service context; actual office/service must come from the authorized configuration.

title: Payment declaration
body: The office has not declared whether payment is required.
annotation: Pending-declaration variant has no amount field. Selection and save are design routes only, not a live configuration write. No fee is charged and no existing request is moved to Processing by this declaration. Registrar and enrollment certificate are illustrative service context; actual office/service must come from the authorized configuration.

title: Reject request
body: Enter the reason for rejecting this request.
annotation: Empty-field submit deliberately routes to validation, not confirmation. Actual nonempty input would reach G06.staff-reject-confirm only after validation. Static prototype does not claim to accept or save typed input. Show only an authorized staff transition.

title: Reject request
body: A reason is required before this request can be rejected.
annotation: Focus the reason field in implementation; no request state changes. Confirmation fixture is separately reachable in the review catalog and does not imply an edit occurred.

title: Reject this request?
body: Review the reason before confirming rejection.

sections.title: Payment remains recorded
sections.body: For this paid-request example, rejection does not automatically refund or void the payment. Refer payment follow-up to Cashiering.

annotation: Explicit paid-request confirmation fixture. Actual UI must show the real affected reference/service and validated reason. Paid notice is conditional, not shown for free/unpaid requests. Prototype navigation performs no server transition.

title: Request rejected
body: This request has stopped. Its payment remains recorded.

sections.title: Payment follow-up
sections.body: Rejection does not automatically refund or void a payment.

sections.text: The confirmed reason, staff actor and time appear in status history.

annotation: Distinct rejected result; do not route View request to an old Processing detail. Actual result waits for server confirmation, preserves paid record and logs real reason/actor/time. Cashiering contact is through authorized office inquiry destinations only.

title: Cancel request
body: Enter the reason for cancelling this request.
annotation: Empty-field submit deliberately routes to validation. Valid nonempty input would reach G06.staff-cancel-confirm only after validation. Static prototype does not claim successful editing. No cancellation deadline or additional authority is invented.

title: Cancel request
body: A reason is required before this request can be cancelled.
annotation: No transition occurs. Keep empty reason visible with adjacent validation; actual field gets focus. Confirmation fixture is a separate review example.

title: Cancel this request?
body: Review the reason before confirming cancellation.

sections.title: Payment remains recorded
sections.body: For this paid-request example, cancellation does not automatically refund or void the payment. Refer payment follow-up to Cashiering.

annotation: Paid-request confirmation fixture, distinct from rejection. Show actual validated reason and reference in implementation. Paid notice is conditional; prototype does not execute a cancellation.

title: Request cancelled
body: This request has stopped. Its payment remains recorded.

sections.title: Payment follow-up
sections.body: Cancellation does not automatically refund or void a payment.

sections.text: The confirmed reason, staff actor and time appear in status history.

annotation: Distinct cancelled result; do not confuse with rejection or an old Processing preview. Actual success requires confirmation and preserves the paid payment record. Cashiering contact requires an authorized office-inquiry destination.

title: Cancel this request?
body: Review your reason before confirming cancellation.
annotation: No paid-payment notice. Actual nonempty reason and real affected record are required. Remap free student reason/cancellation context to G04.detail-free rather than the old paid Processing example. G06.4 must show terminal Cancelled detail/result.
